ambient_events: A drum of something settles with a deep, resonant glug.
The extractor fans overhead never quite clear the chemical tang.
description: A concrete warehouse-shop stacked to the rafters with drums, glassware, coils of tubing and a wall of little drawers labelled by thread pitch. A forklift idles in the aisle and a clipboard-and-ballpoint sign-out sheet does duty as the entire compliance department.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window

name: Screw It
